changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.99[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]WeTrakr[/COLOR]
-New fifth tracking service, WeTrakr. It works on its own, like Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList and PunchPlay, and is authorized in Settings > Tracking Accounts with a code and a QR, the same way as the others.
-Live scrobbling: WeTrakr shows what you are watching, follows your pauses and resumes, and keeps the position up to date while you watch (every 2 minutes by default).
-WeTrakr marks a movie or episode as watched from 80%. Below that, the session stays paused so you can resume it later from any device.
-If WeTrakr matches a different episode than the one playing (absolute against season numbering), the session is cancelled instead of marking the wrong episode.
-New WeTrakr folder in Movies and TV Shows: Watchlist, Continue Watching, Next Episodes, My Lists, Liked Lists, Followed Lists, Favorites, My Ratings, Watched, Watch History, Recommended for You, Top Rated, Trending Lists, and personal calendars for upcoming episodes and movie releases.
-WeTrakr Trending and Popular in Movies and TV Shows, shown once your account is authorized.
-New WeTrakr Manager in the context menu of movies, TV shows and episodes. It shows the current state of each title on WeTrakr and lets you mark as watched or remove the last play, add to or remove from the Watchlist and Favorites, rate or change your rating, add to or remove from your lists, put a show on hold, drop it or move it back to Watching, and remove a title from Continue Watching.
-Continue Watching resumes movies and episodes where you left off, on this device or another one.
-Changes made on the WeTrakr website or app show up in luc_kodi within 5 minutes. Force WeTrakr Sync refreshes everything at once.
-Lists that WeTrakr locks on free accounts (followed lists, or lists over the plan limit) are shown as locked.
[COLOR fffdb515]Settings[/COLOR]
-Tracking Accounts: new WeTrakr section with Authorize, Account info (plan and requests left today), Force WeTrakr Sync, scrobble, scrobble notification and update interval.
-Navigation: WeTrakr Trending, Popular and folder entries for Movies and TV Shows.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Saving the resume point no longer fails for a title without a year. It stopped with an error and the position was lost.
-Clearing resume points now finds Kodi's real video database. It looked for a fixed file name per Kodi version that was wrong on Kodi 21 (an empty database file was created next to the real one) and missing on Kodi 22 and later, which logged "unable to open database file" every time playback stopped.
